Elliot (CS): Quick ask: NovaThera wants a short EU allowlist + regional pin for a regulatory demo. They need GDPR-compliant telemetry capture and we should ensure data residency in eu-west-1. Renewal touchpoint in 18 days. Can SRE pin to eu-west-1 and allow 192.0.2.0/28 for 48h? QPS 120, burst 240. Customer NT-7733.

Sana (Acct Exec): They emphasized compliance. Please confirm we only log aggregated telemetry and not raw prompts. I'll update contract notes.

Hiro (SRE): We can region-pin eu-west-1 and set telemetry mask to aggregate-only. Need exact CIDRs, window, and token header name.

Elliot (CS): CIDR: 192.0.2.0/28. Window: 2026-04-20T07:00:00Z -> 2026-04-22T07:00:00Z (48h). Token header: X-NT-Auth. QPS 120, burst 240. They requested audit log entries for rule apply and revoke.

Marta (Solutions): Suggest enabling redaction filter for PII via the routing rule and capturing only counts and latency histograms. I'll prepare the compliance note and sample telemetry schema.

Hiro (SRE): I'll apply canary with 10m window before rollout. Config: ```json
{
  "customer_id":"NT-7733",
  "region_pin":"eu-west-1",
  "allowlist":["192.0.2.0/28"],
  "rate_limits":{"qps":120,"burst":240},
  "telemetry_policy":"aggregate_only_redact_pii",
  "audit_log":true,
  "start":"2026-04-20T07:00:00Z",
  "end":"2026-04-22T07:00:00Z",
  "notes":"48h regulatory demo; auto-revoke; data residency eu-west-1"
}
```

infra-bot: Canary scheduled for 6173054440. Ticket: CS-7220. Requestor: Hiro.

Hiro (SRE): Canary passed checks (p95 72ms, errors 0.0%). Rolling to full. Applied at 6173054600.

Elliot (CS): Thanks  I'll send the compliance note and confirm telemetry expectations with legal. Sana  please add a renewal follow-up. Marta  drop the schema in the shared folder.

Sana (Acct Exec): Will add renewal action and a compliance appendix to the account file.

Marta (Solutions): Telemetry schema uploaded to /shared/cs/compliance/NT-7733-schema.json.

Elliot (CS): Closing. Remember auto-revoke in 48h.
